name: fh-fuelhunt
title: Fuel Station Finder
description: Find the cheapest fuel near you in South Africa. Search by location, filter by fuel type, get directions.
audience: South African drivers, fleet managers, and anyone who buys fuel regularly and wants to stop overpaying at the nearest station when a cheaper one is five minutes away.
useCases: A driver on an unfamiliar route needs diesel — opens the app, sees the cheapest station within 5km, and gets turn-by-turn directions
A fleet manager compares fuel costs across a city — checks 30-day price trends to decide which stations to assign to drivers
A commuter notices prices vary by R2/litre between stations on their route — uses the app to find the cheapest stop on the way to work each morning
A long-distance traveller plans fuel stops before a road trip — searches stations along the route by town name and fuel type

dataPrivacy.storage: Station data stored in cloud database. User preferences (theme, filters) stored locally on device.
dataPrivacy.authentication: Not required for browsing. Admin features require sign-in.
dataPrivacy.location: GPS location used only for finding nearby stations. Not stored server-side.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: Mapbox for maps and geocoding. Supabase for station data.
